name: publishmatic CONTENT
author: jwieneke

sections.description:
Publish your content in seconds – fully formatted and structured in Elementor.

Publishmatic CONTENT is a WordPress plugin that helps Elementor users save time and eliminate manual publishing steps. Instead of copying and pasting every single paragraph, heading, image, or list into Elementor manually, publishmatic does the work for you – clean, structured and optimized.

Our HTML Converter (https://publishmatic.com/publishmatic-content/convert-to-html/) converts your content (e.g. from Google Docs, ChatGPT, Word, etc.) into clean HTML. Our Plugin automatically adds it to separate Elementor containers using the right widgets (e.g. Text Editor, Heading, Image). You maintain full design flexibility and can add templates, CTAs, forms, images, or videos exactly where you need them.

Perfect for bloggers, SEO agencies, content creators, VAs and web designers who want to publish more – faster and without errors.

Features

  • Automatically converts content into clean HTML
  • Creates separate containers for each paragraph, heading, list, image, etc.
  • Automatically adds the correct Elementor widgets
  • Smart link detection (external links open in new tab)
  • Works with Elementor Free & Pro
  • No API required, no technical setup
  • Insert up to 500 words for free
  • Compatible with all themes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/publishmatic-content/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Elementor editor and search for the widget called “publishmatic CONTENT”.
  4. Drag the widget into your page where you want to insert the content.
  5. Paste your content (as plain HTML, e.g. converted by our HTML Converter from Google Docs, Word, ChatGPT etc.) into the input field of the widget.
  6. Click “Insert content” – done!

No API key or complex setup required.
sections.faq:
What kind of content can I use?

Any plain or lightly formatted content (e.g. from Google Docs, ChatGPT, Word, etc.). Our HTML Converter will clean it and our Plugin will insert the correct HTML structure.

Can I still add templates, images, or forms afterwards?

Yes! publishmatic inserts each block of content into its own Elementor container using the correct widget. You can add anything between the blocks – just like with manually added content.

Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works with both Elementor Free and Pro.

Do I need an API key or do I have to register somewhere?

No. Just install the plugin and start publishing.

How many words can I use for free?

The Free version allows inserting content with up to 500 words. In our Pro version, you have an unlimited number of words.

Will external links open in a new tab?

Yes. The plugin detects external links and sets them to target="_blank" automatically.
